recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone composition featuring a vertical organic panel on the left containing bubbly hand-drawn lettering, and a large halftone-textured photograph of a performer on the right, all framed by a solid border.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between organic typographic column and photographic field
Interaction between coarse halftone dots and solid color blocks
Fluid, melting letterforms contained within a wobbly white-outlined container
Monochromatic photo tinting matching the primary accent color
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone screen texture on the photographic element
Limited two-color palette (orange and dark brown/black)
Organic, hand-drawn quality to all borders and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A close-up of a singer with a microphone dominates the right two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical orange column on the left acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left lettering, flow down the vertical column, then sweep across the diagonal of the singer's face and microphone.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured background behind the singer provides heavy visual weight.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant orange used for the border, text container, and photo highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or dark brown used for the halftone shadows and background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White used as a thin, vibrating outline for the text and its container.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the saturated orange and the near-black dark tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded sans-serif with extreme weight variation
letterConstructionRules: Liquid, melting appearance with varying baseline and cap height
Thick, bulbous strokes with small, tight counters
Letters are squeezed together to fit the narrow vertical column
Outer white stroke follows the irregular perimeter of the letter group
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' has a heavy, sagging bottom curve
The 'O' is an irregular, squashed circle
The 'K' has a fluid, branch-like junction

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a separate graphic panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettering style used for all text to maintain a cohesive 'melting' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s psychedelic poster aesthetic perfectly.
A font-based starting point for the rounded, retro feel before manual distortion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a duotone image in orange and dark charcoal. The right side features a coarse halftone-screened photo of a man singing into a microphone. The left side features a vertical, wobbly-edged orange panel outlined in white. A solid orange border frames the entire square composition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn bubble lettering inside the orange panel. The letters should appear liquid and melting, colored orange with a thin white outline, stacked vertically to fit the narrow space.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone screen visible and coarse?
Does the lettering look hand-drawn and fluid?
Is the palette strictly limited to orange, dark charcoal, and white?
Is the vertical panel's edge irregular and organic?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone dots don't look like digital noise.
Check that the white outline is consistent around the text.
Verify the orange color is vibrant and not muddy.
Confirm the composition is split roughly 1/3 to 2/3.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Halftone Subject] with [Organic Vertical Panel] using [Two-Tone Palette] and [Liquid Bubble Lettering].
